guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: GWRS將膜處理與UV/H₂O₂後的水送至補注系統。本課追蹤水質障壁、補注能力與地下水傳輸，避免把地下水視為無限儲槽。
guides.conceptEn: GWRS sends membrane- and UV/H₂O₂-treated water to recharge systems. This lesson follows barriers, recharge capacity and aquifer transport without assuming unlimited groundwater storage.
procedure: 先點選「微濾前處理」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把可用膜面積降成1920 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 50 L/(m²·h)。與基準 40 L/(m²·h)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「逆滲透水量分流」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把產水量改成80 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 80 %。與基準 75 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「產水溶質驗證」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Cp改成10 mg/L，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 98 %。與基準 99 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「濃水獨立處置帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Qp改成80 m³/h，Cp固定，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2480 mg/L。與基準 1985 mg/L比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「UV/AOP光量子模型」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把假想強度降成1.5 mW/cm²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 22.5 mJ/cm²。與基準 30 mJ/cm²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「多重障壁證據」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Nout改成1000，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2 log10。與基準 3 log10比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「補注池入滲介面」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把K減成3 m/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 120 m³/d。與基準 200 m³/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「觀測井與含水層傳輸」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把梯度改成0.04，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 125 d。與基準 250 d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「輸送與注入能耗」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 19.62 kW。與基準 16.35 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「配對井水與儀表樣品」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
procedureEn: Select the microfiltration pretreatment measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only active membrane area to1920 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 50 L/(m²·h). Compare with baseline 40 L/(m²·h) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the RO water split measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only permeate to80 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 80 %. Compare with baseline 75 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the permeate-solute verification measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Cp to10 mg/L with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 98 %. Compare with baseline 99 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the separate concentrate ledger measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Qp to80 m³/h while holding Cp fixed with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2480 mg/L. Compare with baseline 1985 mg/L and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the UV/AOP fluence submodel measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only hypothetical intensity to1.5 mW/cm² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 22.5 mJ/cm². Compare with baseline 30 mJ/cm² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the multiple-barrier evidence measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Nout to1000 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2 log10. Compare with baseline 3 log10 and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the recharge-basin interface measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only K to3 m/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 120 m³/d. Compare with baseline 200 m³/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the monitoring wells and aquifer transport measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only gradient to0.04 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 125 d. Compare with baseline 250 d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the conveyance and injection energy measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 19.62 kW. Compare with baseline 16.35 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the paired well-water and sensor samples measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
evidence: 以產水總表與各膜列面積核對，另記反洗時間。在離線場景為「微濾前處理」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
校核Qf=Qp+Qc，檢查三支流量表的時間同步。在離線場景為「逆滲透水量分流」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以標準液校正導電度，並用實驗室分析驗證目標溶質。在離線場景為「產水溶質驗證」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以進水、產水與濃水三點配對樣核對鹽負荷。在離線場景為「濃水獨立處置帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
比較燈強度、透光率與流量，指出單一探頭代表不了所有流線。在離線場景為「UV/AOP光量子模型」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
紀錄檢出限，區分未檢出與零；檢查共同失效是否影響多個障壁。在離線場景為「多重障壁證據」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以觀測井水頭求梯度，分開估計K與有效孔隙率。在離線場景為「補注池入滲介面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用保守示蹤與觀測井分布比較最早突破，不能只看平均。在離線場景為「觀測井與含水層傳輸」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「輸送與注入能耗」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「配對井水與儀表樣品」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
evidenceEn: Reconcile total permeate with each train area and separately log backwash time. Build an offline evidence table for microfiltration pretreatment; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
Check Qf=Qp+Qc and synchronize the three flow meters. Build an offline evidence table for RO water split; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Calibrate conductivity with standards and verify the target solute with laboratory analysis. Build an offline evidence table for permeate-solute verification; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use paired samples of feed, permeate and concentrate to check salt loads. Build an offline evidence table for separate concentrate ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare lamp intensity, transmittance and flow, explaining why one sensor does not represent all streamlines. Build an offline evidence table for UV/AOP fluence submodel; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Record detection limits, distinguish non-detect from zero, and inspect common failures across barriers. Build an offline evidence table for multiple-barrier evidence; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use observation-well heads to estimate gradient and estimate K separately from effective porosity. Build an offline evidence table for recharge-basin interface; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare early breakthrough using a conservative tracer and monitoring wells, not only the mean. Build an offline evidence table for monitoring wells and aquifer transport; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for conveyance and injection energy; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for paired well-water and sensor samples; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
pitfalls: 未扣停用膜列會低估剩餘膜列的真實通量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
濃水表偏低會製造虛假的高回收，須做總水量平衡。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
膜破損、密封旁通與探頭漂移都可能使產水讀值上升。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
只計產水品質而不計濃水，會把污染轉移誤認成消失。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
套管結垢與水中懸浮物可同時降低有效光量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
把未檢出當零會算出無限去除，失去可驗證性。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
細粒堵塞可降低K，即使水頭相同補注率仍會下降。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
砂礫透鏡造成的快速通道會使平均模型過於樂觀。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
pitfallsEn: Counting offline trains understates flux on the remaining membranes. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
An under-reading concentrate meter creates false high recovery; close the water balance. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Membrane damage, seal bypass and sensor drift can all raise the permeate reading. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Checking only permeate quality mistakes transferred pollution for disappearance. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Sleeve fouling and suspended particles can both reduce effective fluence. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Treating non-detect as zero gives infinite removal and is unverifiable. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Fine-particle clogging can reduce K and recharge at the same head. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A permeable gravel lens can make the mean model overoptimistic. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 新加坡新生水系統
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.
